questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

I say a small

A- prayer whenever I ring

B- next assignment

C- the doorbell to my
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **ACB**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the above question we find that: 

 
• The first fixed part ends with an adjective **small**. 
 
• Therefore it should be followed by a **noun**. 
 
• Out of all the given options, only **A **starts with a **noun**. 
 
• In option **1 ABC **we find that it ends with **C **which has a possessive pronoun '**my**' in the end. 
 
• Since a sentence cannot end with a possessive pronoun **option 1 ****ABC **can be eliminated. 
 
• This leaves us with the final option starting with **A **i.e **ACB**. 
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **ACB**.

The correct sentence will be: ***I say a small prayer whenever I ring the doorbell to my next assignment****.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

We kept aside our clothes, (clean) our hiking boots and made sure we had our thick woollen socks.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Cleaned**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the given sentence we find that: 

 
• The verb **kept **is used in the first part of the sentence. 
 
• Therefore the sentence is in the simple past tense. 
 
• Thus the tense of the other verbs must align with the tense of the sentence. 
 
• For the verb **clean**, its **simple past tense** is **cleaned**. 

Therefore the correct answer is **Cleaned**. 

The correct sentence will be: *We kept aside our clothes, **cleaned** our hiking boots and made sure we had our thick woollen socks. *

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

The diesel engines replaced the steam engines and the old ﬁrst class coaches (is replaced) by coupes in a corridor.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Were replaced**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the sentence we find that: 

 
• The verb "**replaced**" shows the sentence is in the simple past tense.
 
• So,** past tense** should be used further as well. Therefore, option 4 is wrong. 
 
• Also, there are two subjects- the steam engines and the old first-class coaches.
 
• That means, plural subject, so according to the **sub-verb agreement,** the plural verb should be used. Thus, option 1 is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice form in the **simple past tense.**
 
• **T**hus, the helping verb "**were**" is used with V3, i.e. **replaced. **So, option 2 i.e. "**were replaced**" is the correct answer.

Therefore the correct answer is **Were replaced**.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.**

Ram said, “I met her yesterday.”

options.text: Ram said that he met her yesterday.
Ram said he meet her the day before.
Ram said that he had met her the day before.
Ram met her the day before.

questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, direct speech is given. So, we change it into indirect speech. The sentence in inverted commas is given in simple past tense. So, it changes into past perfect tense in indirect. Thus, **option 3 **is the correct answer.

Obj + was/were + V3 +by +Sub.

Thus, **option 2 **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

A youth is ______ who is not a child anymore and is yet to enter adulthood.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, a positive word should be used because "not" is already given. Thus, option 2 is incorrect. And, "anyone" is used for a question or to produce a negative meaning. But, the phrase is complete till the blank, after that another phrase starts. So, option 3 is eliminated. And, 'every' is determiner that is used to point out noun but now relative pronoun "who". So, option 4 is wrong. Thus, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
